"""Order representations for the event bus and the CSV export."""

TAX_RATE = 0.08


def order_created_event(order):
    payload = {
        "id": order["id"],
        "customer": order["customer"]["name"].strip().title(),
        "total": round(
            sum(line["qty"] * line["unit_price"] for line in order["lines"]) * (1 + TAX_RATE), 2
        ),
        "lines": len(order["lines"]),
    }
    return {"type": "order.created", "version": 2, "payload": payload}


def order_row(order):
    summary = {
        "id": order["id"],
        "customer": order["customer"]["name"].strip().title(),
        "total": round(
            sum(line["qty"] * line["unit_price"] for line in order["lines"]) * (1 + TAX_RATE), 2
        ),
        "lines": len(order["lines"]),
    }
    return [str(summary["id"]), summary["customer"], f"{summary['total']:.2f}", str(summary["lines"])]
